c.v: The XTAL32K watchdog timer on ESP32-S3 is used to monitor the status of external crystal XTAL32K_CLK.
This watchdog timer can detect the oscillation failure of XTAL32K_CLK, change the clock source of RTC, etc. When XTAL32K_CLK works as the clock source of RTC_SLOW_CLK (for clock description, see

) and stops oscillating, the XTAL32K watchdog timer first switches to BACKUP32K_CLK derived from RC_SLOW_CLK and generates an interrupt (if the chip is in Light-sleep or Deep-sleep mode, the CPU will be woken up), and then switches back to XTAL32K_CLK after it is restarted by software.
